thread:
Asha (Marketing): Quick sync — Wed 3pm PST webinar final runthrough. Need confirmations on registration page copy + consent checkbox, Zoom recording & backup, auto-clips, SRT captions, HubSpot routing, and post-event emails. Who's on?
Tom (Events): I'm on. Consent copy I proposed in the doc: 'By registering you consent to receiving follow-up materials and product updates. Unsubscribe anytime.' ok?
Lena (Legal): prefer 'product updates' -> 'occasional product emails' and legal requires opt-out link visible. Also checkbox must be unchecked by default.
Asha (Marketing): agree — checkbox unchecked. Lena can you paste final text here?
Lena (Legal): Final: 'I agree to receive follow-up emails about the webinar and related product updates. Consent is optional; unsubscribe link included.'
Sam (Growth): HubSpot mapping: add registrant to list 'Webinar_Apr26'; capture UTM params (campaign=webinar_apr26), tag source=signup-page. After recording upload, trigger workflow 'Webinar - OnDemand Nurture'.
OpsBot (Automations): Zoom recording updated: cloud recording ON, separate audio ON, record active speaker + gallery. Smart filename: {{meeting_id}}_webinar_apr26.mp4.
OpsBot (Automations): Auto-clip service scheduled 1h after meeting end. Clips -> GCS bucket redwood-webinars/apr26/clips/; filename pattern speaker_first_last_start_end.mp4. To opt-out add tag 'no-clips' in event metadata.
Tom (Events): Need captions — enable live transcription and SRT export. Can someone confirm captions will be exported reliably? We've had failures before.
Lena (Legal): I'll enable live transcription and request SRT export. Also host should read recording consent script at start: 'This webinar will be recorded; by remaining you consent to being recorded.'
Asha (Marketing): Email flows: 0m immediate thank-you + calendar link; 1h replay early-access with a 20s highlight clip; 24h full recording + transcript + CTA; 3 days reminder to watch + benchmark whitepaper CTA. Sam, confirm send windows?
Sam (Growth): Confirmed. 0m: workflow 'webinar_reg_confirm'; 1h: send to attendees only (filter attendance>2 mins); 24h: send to all registrants; 3 days: send to non-openers only.
Priya (Design): I'll produce two thumbnails: 1280x720 (recording) and 600x338 (social). Uploading to assets by EOD Tue.
Asha (Marketing): Speaker release forms — legal needs signed opt-ins by EOD Tue. Lena, can you handle DocuSign?
Lena (Legal): On it — will send and track signatures.
Tom (Events): Host tech checklist: mute on join, spotlight main speaker, record to cloud, verify captions, share slides from presenter laptop, use Q&A. Backup: record local copy as fallback. Quick host trick: run `zoomctl record-local --path /local/backups/` on presenter's laptop.
Asha (Marketing): Backup plan OK. Post-event ops: upload cloud/local recording to GCS, trigger clipper lambda, set HS property 'recording_uploaded' = true.
OpsBot (Automations): GCS upload webhook is live: /webhooks/zoom-upload -> gcs://redwood-webinars/apr26. Clipper job scheduled 10m after upload. Playback URL pattern: https://playback.redwood.ai/webinars/apr26/{{file}}
Sam (Growth): Analytics tags: add webinar_type=benchmarks, audience=platform-engineering. We also want a token-level benchmark excerpt in the highlight clip — ask speaker to call out 2-3 key numbers during session.
Priya (Design): Will create three 20s highlight templates for socials. Any preferred copy?
Asha (Marketing): Draft copy: 'New latency & cost benchmarks for LLM serving — watch 20s highlight' — Marketing to iterate.
Tom (Events): Tech side all set. @Asha will you post the final host running sheet in #marketing-ops by 1pm Wed?
Asha (Marketing): Yes — I'll post host sheet + rehearsal recording link and the final timeline. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
